series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): Rentaro's morning with his girlfriends is effortless until the group reaches a crowded park and unfamiliar banners rise over the treeline.
Prior events (Part 2): A contest for the right to stand beside Rentaro turns physical, and a towering woman in purple starts throwing grown men into the sky.
Prior events (Part 3): The chaos collapses into comedy, then Hakari takes the center of the crowd and her bright smile starts drifting somewhere far away.
